rows.basis: Q2 2024 release says TeraWulf bought a 128-GPU NVIDIA cluster financed by an OEM, and upgraded Lake Mariner's interconnection, liquid cooling and power redundancy for AI. No dollar amount is given, and there is no HPC segment capex. PP&E growth is in miners, leasehold improvements and construction in process, none of which is HPC-specific.

No HPC segment capex, no stated FY2025 AI amount, and no GPU/HPC-specific PP&E category. Construction in process rose from 107.6M to 1,069.1M, but the note does not split HPC from mining, so it is not used. Seller-side signal: HPC lease revenue of 16.9M in FY2025 (fact:WULF|segment_revenue|HPC lease revenue|FY2025) shows HPC capacity began earning.

Q2 2024 release describes TeraWulf's 30% equity contribution to building CB-1, a 20 MW (gross) liquid-cooled HPC/AI facility expected to be substantially complete by year-end. No dollar amount is given.

Q3 2025 release says a $3.2B senior secured notes offering finances construction of 522.5 MW of AI/HPC data centers at Lake Mariner. That is a financing amount, not a stated capex figure for the year. The FY2025 MD&A says capital allocation going forward is centered on HPC data center development.
